jobs.description:
We are looking for a temporary warehouse operative for an international company in Zaventem, to strengthen the team in the PNR area.

As a warehouse operative in the PNR area, you will support the warehouse team with the following tasks:
 

 
• Carrying out physical stock counts. 
 
•  
 Packing and protecting goods for transport. 

 
•  
 Accurately processing and recording stock counts. 

 
• Providing administrative support for stock checks (SAP and Excel). 
 
•  
 Carrying out limited internal transport activities within the site.

 
• You can communicate fluently in English. 
 
•  
 You have experience working in a warehouse environment. 

 
• A forklift certificate is an asset. 
 

 
• You are available immediately. 
 

 
• You are hands-on and enjoy physical work.

Are you detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a dynamic international environment?

We are looking for a Contract & Order Management Officer to support the commercial operations and ensure the seamless handling of contracts, quotations, and purchase orders.

As part of the team, you will play a key role in supporting the end-to-end contract and order management process by:

• Managing business contracts, including approval workflows and electronic signatures.
• Preparing and processing quotations while helping to standardize and optimize existing processes.
• Reviewing purchase orders for completeness, consistency, and accuracy, and ensuring timely processing and communication.
• Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders through proactive communication on contract and order status.
• Developing expertise in the business you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks, and quotation processes.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a medium-sized to large organization or a complex business environment.
• Initial experience in contract management, sales administration/support, or a paralegal role.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a focus on quality and accuracy.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving work environment.
• Comfortable managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.
• Tech-savvy, with experience using tools such as Microsoft Office, MS Dynamics CRM, and OneDrive.
• Fluent in English

Do you enjoy coaching a team, solving customer issues and improving how things work?
 

For an international B2B company in 
Zaventem, MetiSelect is looking for a 
Customer Service Team Leader.
 

You will lead a team of 
four to five Customer Care colleagues and work closely with the Regional Business Manager. Alongside the daily team coordination, you will follow up on commercial agreements, prepare reports and help improve the service provided to customers and business partners.
 

You make sure your team knows what needs to happen, has the support to do it and follows customer requests through to completion.
 

Your responsibilities include the following.
 
 

•  

Lead and coach your team. Organise the workload, coordinate leave, support new colleagues and follow up on individual and team performance.
  

•  

Help resolve complex customer issues. Work with Sales, Finance and Supply Chain to find solutions and keep customers informed.
  

•  

Manage an existing partner relationship. Be the main operational contact for one business partner in Turkey, discussing open requests and coordinating follow-up internally.
  

•  

Follow up on commercial agreements. Keep track of pricing updates, contract deadlines, renewals and agreed discounts, working with the relevant colleagues in Sales, Finance and Legal.
  

•  

Use data to improve service. Prepare reports and maintain dashboards to monitor response times, open requests and commercial results.
  

•  

Improve processes. Investigate recurring problems and work with colleagues, including IT, to make workflows clearer and more efficient.
  

•  

Support the use of Salesforce. Help maintain accurate customer information and, as you become familiar with the system, support colleagues with questions and consistent ways of working.
  
 

•  

You have experience in 
B2B customer service, sales support, order management or commercial operations. You enjoy helping people develop while staying involved in the daily work.
  

•  

You bring 
at least five years of relevant experience, including experience directly managing a team.
  

•  

You have coached colleagues, set priorities and followed up on their performance.
  

•  

You understand how customer requests, commercial agreements and internal processes connect.
  

•  

You are comfortable using 
Excel, reports and KPIs to identify problems and decide what needs attention.
  

•  

You have worked with an 
ERP system, such as SAP or Dynamics. 
Salesforce experience is a strong advantage. Training can be considered if your wider experience fits the role.
  

•  

You communicate confidently in 
professional English. German or Italian is a plus.
  

•  

You take initiative, keep track of commitments and involve the right people to get things resolved.

You've gained your first experience in accounting administration. Now you're looking for more variety, more responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact.

Our client, part of an international high-tech group, is building its Belgian operations in Zaventem. With a growing team of around 30 colleagues, we're looking for a hands-on Administration & Accounting Officer who enjoys working with figures, keeping things organised and making things happen.

You'll be the local go-to person for administration and accounting, reporting to the accounting team at the group’s headquarters and working directly with the Plant Manager.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do?

No two days will be quite the same. You’ll combine day-to-day accounting administration with administrative support to the Plant Manager and the monthly payroll coordination.

Accounting administration

• Encode accounting documents in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: supplier invoices, credit notes, purchase orders and expense reports. 
• Match invoices with orders and deliveries, and follow up on discrepancies with suppliers and colleagues.
• Follow up on open items and payments.
• Prepare the information the HQ accounting team needs for the monthly closing and answer their questions.
• Keep the accounting files complete, well organised and audit-ready.
Administration – Support to the Plant Manager

• Provide administrative support to the Plant Manager: 
• Keep the local administration up to date and help improve administrative processes as the team grows.
Payroll 

Coordinate the monthly payroll with Acerta: collect and send the variable data, follow up on questions and check payslips before validation.

• Encode payroll-related documents such as contract changes, absences, leave and overtime.
• Record payroll data in Dynamics 365 for the HQ accounting team.
You won’t be expected to know every system from day one. Your precision, organisational skills and willingness to learn are what matter most

What do you bring?

• A Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in accounting or a related field.
• 2 to 3 years of experience in accounting administration, ideally combined with payroll support.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or a similar ERP.
• Experience with Acerta or another Belgian social secretariat is an asset.
• Excellent English, essential for communication with the HQ accounting team.
• French and/or Dutch is a strong asset.
• A precise, organised and independent approach.
Above all, you're someone who takes initiative, enjoys helping colleagues and feels comfortable in a small, fast-moving team.

Develop strong relationships with clients and contribute to the growth of premium brands across the Belgian market.

Gain hands-on experience in sales, business development and account management through a structured traineeship program.

Client Details

Our client is looking for ambitious graduates and young professionals to join their Sales Traineeship Program starting in January 2027. This opportunity will provide you with hands-on commercial experience, exposure to high-value client interactions and the chance to develop into a future sales leader.

Designed for high-potential talent, the program combines practical experience, professional development and coaching from experienced commercial professionals.

Description

As a Sales Trainee, you will gain exposure to various aspects of sales and account management while contributing to the growth of premium brands in the Belgian market.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 

• Building strong relationships with clients and business partners.
• Identifying new commercial opportunities and supporting business growth.
• Participating in client meetings and sales negotiations.
• Monitoring market trends and competitor activities.
• Collaborating with experienced sales teams on strategic projects.
 

For this Sales Traineeship, we are looking for driven and ambitious individuals eager to build a successful career in sales.

 

• You recently graduated or have up to 2 years of professional experience.
• You have a strong interest in sales, business development and premium brands.
• You are proactive, resilient and motivated to achieve results.
• You possess excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
• You are fluent in French or Dutch, with a good command of English

For our client, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE.The company specializes in both small and large renovation projects throughout West Flanders. They handle full A-to-Z renovations as well as smaller works such as bathroom renovations, mainly for private clients, with occasional assignments for companies and organizations.

As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, your tasks include:
• Assisting with paving, small renovations, and indoor works
• Preparing renovation works (measuring, basic demolition, preparing materials)
• Installing plasterboard (gyproc), small masonry tasks, and simple carpentry
• Assisting with floor and tile installation and basic interior finishing
• Supporting full renovation projects from A to Z
• Preparing materials, assisting with installation, finishing, and site cleanup
As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, you recognize yourself in the following:

• You have initial experience as a renovation worker
• You speak Dutch or English
• You are not afraid of physical work

For our client in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a motivated GROUNDWORKER.

Our client is a highly driven company with 125 years of experience, specialized in earthworks and the installation of pipelines and landscaping for cities and municipalities.

As a CONSTRUCTION WORKER in the VEURNE region, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

• Sewer installation works
• Installing curbstones and edging
• Construction of cycle paths, roads, and parking areas
• Laying environmental pavement solutions
• Installation of roundabouts and traffic islands
• Laying paving stones and sidewalk tiles
• Small to large-scale earthworks
 

As a GROUNDWORKER in the VEURNE region, you can identify yourself in the following profile:

• You speak Dutch, English, or French fluently;
• You have relevant experience in road construction;
• You hold a valid driving licence B (additional licences are a plus);
• You are able to travel to the company independently (not accessible by public transport);
• You are practical, hands-on, and enjoy working outdoors.
